packageRules.description: Group dev dependency bumps into a single PR to keep review noise down, and let it merge itself once the CI matrix is green: nothing here ships to plugin users
Runtime dependencies ship to users, so only non-breaking bumps merge themselves; majors stay manual
Let a release sit on the registry for a few days before it is eligible to merge unattended, so a pulled or compromised publish is caught before it lands on main
Major bumps always get read by a human, whatever the rules above say
homebridge is the host runtime and its own engines drive this package's declared node support, so surface bumps on the dashboard for review instead of opening PRs automatically
